claims.claim: Causal language models factorize joint sequence likelihood into next-token conditionals with a causal attention mask.
claims.notes: Training token positions can be computed in parallel; autoregressive generation iterates by output token.

claims.claim: A KV cache retains earlier key and value projections for autoregressive decoding, avoiding repeated computation of the same prefix at the cost of memory.
claims.notes: GQA and MQA may use a different number of KV heads from query heads; toy code tests shape only.

claims.claim: Original RAG combines parametric generation with external non-parametric memory and considers RAG-Sequence and RAG-Token formulations.
claims.notes: Modern concatenate-top-k systems are engineering variants rather than literal reproductions of the original marginalization.

claims.claim: Retrieved documents and tool responses are untrusted external content; prompt instruction alone cannot enforce access permissions.
claims.locator: Least privilege and indirect injection controls
claims.notes: Authorization must be enforced before retrieval/context assembly and again at tool boundary.

claims.claim: Recall@k evaluates retrieval coverage of a labeled relevant-document set and differs from answer groundedness, correctness, or citation support.
claims.notes: Incomplete ground-truth relevance sets invalidate naive absolute Recall@k interpretation.

claims.claim: ReAct interleaves reasoning and environment actions for tasks requiring interactions with external sources.
claims.notes: The article does not imply ReAct eliminates the need for trusted policy checks and audit logs.

claims.claim: LoRA freezes pretrained weight W0 and learns a low-rank update BA, often scaled by alpha/r, with r(din+dout) new parameters.
claims.notes: Parameter savings depend on selected target modules, rank and any other unfrozen parameters.

claims.claim: For W0[dout,din], A[r,din] and B[dout,r], update BA has shape [dout,din].
claims.notes: Shape and parameter count follow directly from matrix multiplication; checked by PyTorch demonstration.

claims.claim: The text's tiny retrieval experiment uses scikit-learn character n-gram TF-IDF, not semantic embeddings or a production vector database.
claims.notes: Synthetic enterprise policy snippets are fabricated teaching inputs; access filtering is simplified and not a security implementation.
